name: Broken Harbours
source:
Broken Harbours is a story about friendship and its limits, new beginnings and old wounds. Follow two solitary souls, Rune and Devon, through the beginnings of their friendship and see where the mutual fascination will lead them.

[From [url=https://dawn-chorus.itch.io/brokenharbours]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《破碎的港口》是一个关于友谊及其局限性、新的开始和旧伤的故事。跟随两个孤独的灵魂，鲁恩和德文，经历他们友谊的开始，看看相互的迷恋将把他们引向何方。

[来自[url=https://dawn-chorus.itch.io/brokenharbours]Itch.io[/url]]
